reviewer: Codex: deterministic rules plus score-blind source/context review; not independent human annotation

policies.target: Local business-call semantic correctness with required evidence/dependencies, not task success or runtime success under the faulty mock.
policies.numeric: Schema-declared numeric fields compare by finite Decimal value; numeric storage strings allowed. IDs/passwords/text are not coerced. Canonical JSON schema validity is reported separately.
policies.retries: A semantically correct call remains locally correct when retried after false mock rejection. Redundancy is separately flagged.
policies.history: Only actually recorded earlier non-error returns supply dynamic facts. No future return is used to supply a missing prerequisite.
policies.calculator: Require all post counts from prior recorded returns; then compare safe arithmetic result with their sum. Also report answer-only sensitivity using offline reference counts.
policies.email: Review recipient, scheduled time/location and factual content; harmless wording changes allowed. Case reviews contain no confidence scores.
policies.address: Allow a sentence-ending period for these five street-address updates; do not normalize arbitrary strings.
policies.AddMeeting: Unknown: original tool schema advertised attendees as string despite canonical list(str); required location was unspecified. Record both defects; do not attribute this as clean agent error.
policies.ClothingRecommendation: Unknown: percentage humidity documentation conflicts with fractional reference values.
policies.underspecified_travel: All business calls in task 35 unknown because travel inputs absent. All HotelAvailability calls unknown because no stay duration/checkout specified. Exclusions independent of scores or original labels.
policies.salary_conversion: Passing the returned salary through is a valid local action. Dividing by 12 is unknown: docs do not specify annual/monthly salary periods, so a reference mismatch alone cannot establish error.
policies.coordinate_sign: Numeric agreement with supplied coordinates is locally supported. A sign change from positive recorded geocoding to negative is unknown for semantic truth because geographic/tool evidence conflicts; additionally record visible-evidence contradiction.
policies.search: ToolSearcher has no reliable semantic gold label in the old mock; retain all four as unknown auxiliary actions, with observed retrieval outcome separately recorded. Exclude from primary business-call metrics.
policies.scope: No missing final-answer/no-tool actions are invented. Zero-call tasks and final answers are preserved but not step-labeled. No task success rate is recomputed.
policies.sampling: All 198 recorded calls retained; no score-based exclusions, resampling or candidate generation.
policies.evaluation: Descriptive reanalysis of already inspected trajectories, not an untouched holdout and not a newly trained calibrator.
